title: Solving Vlasov-Poisson system with an adaptive Hermite spectral method
summary: We propose an adaptive Hermite spectral method for the Vlasov-Poisson system based on a recently developed frequency indicator that measures the contribution of the high-order expansion coefficients. Precisely, the symmetrically weighted Hermite basis with a scaling factor is utilized to approximate the distribution function to satisfy the increasing resolution requirement, which, for example, is induced by filamentation.
